body:
I have taken shrooms only one time before this expirience happened. I have smoked pot everyday for over a year now and needed a different high. My first high on mushrooms was amazing. I tripped out hardcore and was in a good environment, had good vibes going. Later after I came off the shrooms I began to feel pain in the back of my neck and along my spine.
A couple of days later I consumed more mushrooms, about 2 grams. I was feeling sick that day and the day earlier, my stomach was upset already. I decided to take the shrooms anyway. Me and my buds end up walking around tripping out. I felt good giggling and all. It started to rain so we went to my buds house. By then we are all starting to feel the shrooms kick in, so we decide to watch pink floyds the wall. The shrooms start to peak. I started to get these weird bad vibes from the movie. My stomach starts acting up again so I go to the washroom and trip out for a good bit. I remember almost puking then talking myself out of it.
After the peak was gone, everything was restoring itself back to normal, I felt better. I had this weird after buzz effect from the shrooms, which is like I'm stoned on pot except everything seems different, where everything seems new . The objects that are around in my every day life seem to be just bought. Like my bong and buster. It seems as if its not me, but I am someone else expiriencing MY life.
A little while later me and my buds decide to go for a drive. I was kind of dazed. I felt the same pain in the back of my neck and along my spine. We finally go park to smoke some pot. I had about 4 or 5 huge bong hits, which got me fried. I was thinking that the pot would make the neck and back pain go away.
We decide to drive again and this time everything started to go weird... out of nowhere I began to feel this weird sensation.The neck and back pain started to worsen. I was beginning to have a hot flash, like a sweat. I remember ringing in my ears, it started slowly but began to build blocking out everyones voices and all sounds, my neck pain was intense. As I went into the hot flash I remember my body getting numb and tingley. I remember everything going more green and greener...( at first I thought it was me greening out, but I had no urge at all to puke) I remember the world going green very green....until I was completely blinded by this white glow. I couldnt hear, speak, move, see, or feel. I was completely immobalized for about 3 seconds. It was like I simply did not exist for 3 seconds, like the world deteriorated before my eyes, or I deteriorated away...
After those 3 seconds I started to come back. My vision was clearing of the white, I felt my body go cold....like a cold sweat. My hands were tingling again I was talking but my voice seemed muffled, as did everyone elses and all other sounds. The muffling went away as everything  started to clear. My neck was killing me, like a burning sensation. It was hard to move so I went home and laid down. I felt the burning sensation for about 2 hours after, and a sore neck for 5-6 hours. While I was laying down I remember feeling down, and more sensitive to personal problems. This was my second time taking mushrooms and my first bad trip ( I guess you can call it) I would say more of a mixed good and bad expirience.

Don't do it!
